verified.coverageNote: 936 traversal matrix runs contain 906 distinct new programs, with 30 repeated requests from empty/single-element early/late list positions; all enter 15 portable groups. The 7063 direct-read runs overlap 7033 older requests plus 30 root numeric requests. Existing 2810 async value programs are replays, not newly added independent cases. The new traversal cases are not claimed as async coverage.
verified.api: Direct bounded value equality/hash/search; opaque immutable child lookup without full subtree copies or JSON selector transport; detached unwrapped output; successful hash cache only in immutable JS wrappers, never in caller-mutable core Values

performance.scope: Two old JSON-request workloads and eight retained-object workloads compare fixed 0.13, current and native adapters, plus six value/container workloads including both repeated retained hashes and fresh-wrapper hashes. The full baseline JS module dependency tree is loaded from the fixed Git commit. Retained workloads compare real Config methods with native Config; construction excluded, immutable operations/getter transport included, final result serialization excluded. Each workload has five fresh processes; Java legacy and retained workloads use separate processes. Startup, I/O and sustained/peak-memory parity are not measured.
